abstract: OBJECTIVE: There have been few studies concerning the clinical pathology of squamous cell carcinoma arising from ovarian mature cystic teratoma. Thus, the objective of this study is to determine clinicopathologic factors affecting survival in this rare tumor. METHODS: From September 1979 to June 1996, 37 patients with squamous cell carcinoma arising from ovarian mature cystic teratoma were treated by the Tokai Ovarian Tumor Study Group. A retrospective clinicopathologic and survival analysis of these patients was performed. The mode of infiltration was classified into expansive, moderately diffused, and diffused patterns. RESULTS: Although the 5-year survival rate was 94.7% and 80.0% for stage I and II patients, respectively, 12 of 13 patients with stage III died within 20 months (P = .0001). A significant difference was also observed between the survival of the groups with and without residual tumor at surgery (P = .0001). Pathologic features, grade, mode of infiltration, and vascular involvement were significant factors by univariate analysis. Multivariate analysis showed significant differences in survival related to grade (P = .0154) and mode of infiltration (P = .0053). The preoperative squamous cell carcinoma antigen level was significantly higher in the patients with squamous cell carcinoma arising from mature cystic teratoma than in patients with mature cystic teratoma (P < .0001). CONCLUSION: This study suggests that pathologic factors, grade, and mode of infiltration can provide valuable information for predicting the survival of patients with squamous cell carcinoma arising from mature cystic teratoma. In addition, squamous cell carcinoma antigen may be a useful marker to detect this disease preoperatively.
abstract_ja:
目的：卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた扁平上皮癌において、予後に影響する臨床病理学的因子を明らかにすること。
方法：1979年9月から1996年6月までに、東海卵巣腫瘍研究グループが卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた扁平上皮癌の37例を治療した。これらの患者について後方視的な臨床病理学的解析および生存解析を行った。浸潤様式は、膨張性、中等度にびまん性、びまん性の3型に分類した。
結果：病期Iおよび病期IIの患者の5年生存率はそれぞれ94.7%および80.0%であった一方、病期IIIの13例中12例が20か月以内に死亡した（P = .0001）。手術時に残存腫瘍があった群となかった群の間には、生存に有意な差がみられた（P = .0001）。病理学的特徴、悪性度、浸潤様式、脈管侵襲は単変量解析で有意な因子であった。多変量解析では、悪性度（P = .0154）および浸潤様式（P = .0053）により生存に有意差がみられた。術前の扁平上皮癌関連抗原値は、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の患者よりも扁平上皮癌の患者で有意に高かった（P < .0001）。
結論：本研究は、病理学的因子、悪性度、浸潤様式が、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の扁平上皮癌患者の生存予測に有用な情報を与えうることを示唆する。さらに、扁平上皮癌関連抗原は、この疾患を術前に検出するための有用なマーカーとなりうる。
